scope: Partial monitoring from the recorded first sample until final control completion, nominally every ten seconds. Not continuous isolation certification; no retroactive coverage claim.
identification: Match known server stage PIDs from private startup logs or inspect only PYTHONPATH in process/ancestor environments. Initial direct process environments did not identify spawned workers; known startup PIDs resolve these observations. Public report omits PIDs, GPU UUIDs and private paths.
excluded: Processes appearing on cards after our completion markers are other allocations and are excluded.
failed_previous_startup: Unreserved unrelated process occupied the first control card; startup failed before measured requests. Other job left untouched and full controls moved to a free card.
